items.statement: Ines Varga works at Kestrel Fabrication, a small company that builds drone frames.

items.statement: Larkspur must ship by 14 March, the date promised to the pilot customer.

items.statement: Kestrel buys all its carbon tubes and plates from Brannock Composites.
items.source_utterance: All our carbon tubes and plates come from Brannock Composites. Teodor Ilves is the account manager there, and we have a standing call with him Tuesdays at 10:30.

items.statement: Kestrel test-flies its prototypes at Tolvik Flats.

items.statement: Yusuf Demir runs quality assurance at Kestrel.
items.source_utterance: Yusuf Demir runs QA. Anything that fails his checks goes straight back to Hall C, no exceptions.

items.statement: Ines's desk phone extension is 4417.
items.source_utterance: People keep asking how to reach me in the office: desk line is extension 4417, and I sit in room 2.14 on the second floor.

items.statement: The Larkspur specs are on the shared drive under /eng/larkspur/rev-d.
items.source_utterance: All the Larkspur specs are on the shared drive under /eng/larkspur/rev-d. We're on Rev D of the frame now; Rev C had the hinge crack problem.

items.statement: The Larkspur arm hinge bolts are torqued to 2.8 newton-metres.
items.source_utterance: Torque on the arm hinge bolts is 2.8 newton-metres. Write that down, people over-tighten them constantly.

items.statement: Kestrel tracks inventory in Shelfwise.
items.source_utterance: We track inventory in Shelfwise, and every Larkspur part number starts with KF-LS-.

items.statement: Before anyone changes a program on Old Gus: back up the current program to the shared drive, dry-run the new one with the spindle off, cut one test part from scrap aluminium, have Yusuf Demir check it, and only then run production.
items.source_utterance: One rule for Old Gus: before anyone changes a program, back up the current one to the shared drive, dry-run the new one with the spindle off, cut a single test part from scrap aluminium, get Yusuf to check it, and only then run production.
